question: Please tell me the difference in healing ability between Minerva-chan, Ferris, Emilia-tan and the rest, using Godzilla in the example.
answer: Minerva is Godzilla. Ferris is Mothra. Emilia-tan and Rem are around Yagogeruge’s level. Beako is about the same as a Hippolit alien. (note: Yagogeruge is from the Barom-1 series, and Hippolit aliens are from the Ultraman series.)
